title: Not sure if anyone has been here, used AI to create my dream
content: I’ve been to this cabin a couple times. There are usually lions and bears trying to break in and eat my cats. Like I grew up with the lions and they got along with my cats. They were such good friends. Then the lions started hanging around the bears and they started to attack all of us. So I was outside scooping up my cats and trying to bring them inside as the lions and bears are hunting us. It was a pretty scary stressful dream lol.
